title: Make Sum Divisible by P
summary: Given an array of positive integers, identify and remove the shortest contiguous segment whose removal results in the sum of the remaining elements being divisible by a specified integer p.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, identify and remove the shortest contiguous segment whose removal results in the sum of the remaining elements being divisible by a specified integer p. The entire array cannot be removed. Return the length of this segment, or -1 if no such segment exists.
constraints: Remove one contiguous subarray, possibly empty, so the remaining sum is divisible by p.
The entire array may not be removed; return the minimum length or -1.
hints: Let target be the total-sum remainder that the removed subarray must have.
At each prefix remainder r, seek the latest earlier remainder r-target modulo p.
Use the index distance as a candidate and store the latest occurrence of r.
Prefix subtraction enumerates every subarray remainder, while latest indices minimize length.
editorial: Prefix subtraction enumerates every subarray remainder, while latest indices minimize length.

tests.explanation: Removing the single value four leaves sum six, divisible by six.
Removing values five and two leaves nine, so the minimum length is two.
